[[File:Cosmic Baron Dmg.png|thumb|Cosmic Baron with heavy chest damage]]
The '''Cosmic Baron''' is a new enemy in [[Doom: The Dark Ages|''Doom: The Dark Ages'']], acting as a replacement for the demonic Baron of Hell.

==Description==
Crafted through forbidden gene-splicing, its monstrous form embodies the Barons of Hell, a grotesque testament to the unholy fusion of their realms. It is described that some monsters called mollusk synthesists made this abomination.

==Combat Characteristics==
Unlike the Barons from previous entries, this version of the Baron species focuses mostly on rushing down the player with relentless swipes to destroy their Health & Armor. First encountered in the beginning of '''Mission 15: City of Ry'uul''', the Cosmic Baron will rush towards the nearest player at a speed that is similar to one sprinting. Usually when it is close enough, it will first initiate the ground-pound seen in the 2 previous entries, in order to close the gap - this can be parried and results in a stun, leaving it open for melee combos. Afterwards it'll continue it's pursuit by rushing at the player to swipe them 3 times, or more if they missed a parry. These swipes, when parried at least 3 times in a row, will stun the brute and afterwards it'll then jump away to unleash either of 2 attacks, or both - 5 low discs, one of them which is parriable and a blade-wall, one of which is green and being parryable. This ranged attack can also happen after the ground-pound. Like the [[Dread Knight]]s from ''[[Doom Eternal]]'', they also have another version of the ground-pound attack without jumping, which is triggered randomly when close. Obviously, parrying this attack will stun the brute.

== Strategy ==
Despite being one of the more threatening deadlier late-game demons, the strategy is very simple, however you need the [[Chainshot]]'s first upgrade. After every parry, shoot the gun and repeat. This also applies to the [[Impaler]] and the [[Rocket launcher/Doom: The Dark Ages|Rocket Launcher]], because one of their upgrades makes it so that every parry empowers the next shot, so as soon as you hit a parry with either of those weapons you want to shoot right after, then parry and repeat. If the brute is stunned after 3 parried slashes or one parried ground-pound, go in for melee attacks as these can deal lots of damage, mainly the [[Power Gauntlet]] and [[Dreadmace]]. Because of the new update, it is ''highly recommended'' you always parry the ranged attacks as missing one will '''instantly''' destroy your shield, because of the new damage buff.
